digest.component_or_area: overlap queue and ticket digest history
propositions: Physically deleting committed queue and digest events does not reclaim repository space (blobs remain in git history) but breaks cross-clone merges via git rename detection pairing.
The queue reduce is O(history) in file opens (4,977 opens measured for 3,727 tickets) while digest lookup is already O(1), making pending_enrichment the bottleneck exceeding a 20 ms budget by 20x.
A read-bound design using newest-first suffix scans of timestamped filenames achieves the same latest-wins semantics with 1,658 opens instead of 4,977, without deletion or merge semantics change.
Any merge-safe removal must rename to a deterministic source-derived path with identical content; removal paired with fresh-UUID adds is never merge-safe regardless of configuration.
The design preserves all committed UUID events, satisfies invariant I1 (docs/concurrency.md), and leaves the 404 ms listdir dominance unsolved pending a separate store-level indexing effort.
